overlap_checks.scope: Exact normalized wording and exact unweighted graph isomorphism only. Direction is preserved; names, types, attributes, edge values, filters and task semantics are ignored in topology checks. Matches flag possible reuse, not identical task meaning. No-match does not establish semantic independence.

reference.acceptance: Measure error; do not treat epsilon as a certified per-run error bound or require exact stochastic scores.

cases.reason: This question needs connection costs or strengths to affect the calculation, but this analysis does not use those values. Adding cost data would not enable that calculation. I have not run an unweighted substitute.
